title: A double-resonator coupler for high-fidelity two-qubit gates between superconducting qubits
summary: Tunable couplers have enabled two-qubit gate fidelities in superconducting quantum processors to approach $99.9\%$, yet simultaneously suppressing residual interactions and maintaining flexible qubit-frequency allocation remain central challenges for scaling. Here, we propose a double-resonator coupler (DRC) consisting of two resonators interconnected by a single Josephson junction and a capacitor.
